blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – An unexpected loss did not faze Lilia Vargas when her balikbayan niece arrived from Ireland on Monday after suffering a miscarriage. On Monday, All Souls’ Day, Vargas waited for the arrival of her niece and three nephews at the Ninoy Aquino International Airport Terminal 3. The four of them work in Ireland. Lilia was hoping to meet three-month pregnant niece Lilith, who, unfortunately, had a miscarriage a month prior. “Na-surpise kami… Akala namin kasi, may apo na kami.
